info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Market Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates updates to market operations by allowing modifications based on a given parameter. It is particularly useful for adjusting trade confirmation matching settings, enhancing accuracy in financial transactions. Typical consumers include financial institutions and trading platforms that need to refine their market operations. By leveraging this endpoint, clients can ensure their trading strategies are dynamically aligned with market conditions while improving operational efficiency.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the trade confirmation matching details for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It's essential to provide the correct information to ensure the trade confirmation is accurately updated.
